Our quality commitment to you
Since 1935, our mission as the industry leader has been to provide you with the highest-quality nutritional supplements. We continue to stand behind this mission. If you are not 100% satisfied with your purchase, return the unused portion of the product with your receipt within 30 days, and we'll either refund your money or find a replacement product that is right for you.
Includes multivitamin + heart & eye health + brain health + joint health + bone, beauty & hormone formula + antioxidant & circulation + digestive enzymes

Comprehensive support made convenient.
With a multivitamin blend clinically proven to make you feel better, plus targeted solutions for head-to-toe support, our Women's Vitapak Program Whole Body has you covered.

In a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of 112 healthy volunteers, subjects taking the GNC vitamin and mineral blends for six weeks experienced significant improvements in serum levels of certain key nutrients compared to a placebo and a basic multivitamin formula based upon multivariate statistical analysis of a group of B-vitamins (thiamin, niacin, riboflavin, pantothenic acid, biotin, folic acid, and vitamins B-6 and B-12) and key antioxidants and cartenoids (a group of beta-carotene, alpha-tocopherol, selenium, lutein, lycopene). Statistical improvements in SF-36 Vitality and Mental Health scores were also observed compared to placebo. In a 12 week multi-center, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of 60 adults, subjects taking 250mg/day of the joint blend showed a significant 29.8% improvement in joint flexibility and a 19.4% improvement in joint function in 30 days compared to subjects on placebo.
